# Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator

On-demand location, start/stop tracking, and reverse geocoding for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-geolocator
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/NugetWorld
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator

Registration: `UseGeoLocator` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How can I get the current GPS location in .NET MAUI?
- How do I start and stop location tracking in MAUI?
- How do I reverse geocode latitude/longitude in MAUI?
- MAUI geolocation plugin / cross-platform GPS library

## Do not use when

- You only need a single on-demand fix and MAUI Geolocation is enough
- You need Windows or Mac Catalyst as a first-class target
- You need a hosted maps SDK (Google Maps, Mapbox) rather than coordinates
